BirthDateInFuture.en: Birth date cannot be later than {date}.

BindingHelp.zhs: 永久一对一绑定；提交后不能解绑、改绑或重绑
BindingHelp.en: Permanent one-to-one binding. It cannot be removed or reassigned after submission.

NoBindingPermission.zhs: 当前账号没有绑定权限。
NoBindingPermission.en: You do not have permission to bind an account.

BindingInstructions.zhs: 搜索一个普通账号，核对 ECODE、ENAME、状态和 Revision 后提交永久绑定。
BindingInstructions.en: Search for a regular account and review its code, name, status and revision before binding permanently.

DisabledBindingHelp.zhs: 停用人员不能查询候选或提交绑定。
DisabledBindingHelp.en: Disabled people cannot search candidates or submit a binding.

BindingDialogTitle.zhs: 建立人员账号永久绑定

SeparateNames.zhs: Person.Name 与 User.ENAME 分别维护，绑定不会同步名称。
SeparateNames.en: Person and account names are maintained separately. Binding does not synchronize them.

SearchLabel.zhs: 按 ECODE 或 ENAME 搜索
SearchLabel.en: Search by account code or name

LoadingCandidates.zhs: 正在加载最多 20 个可绑定账号…

EmptyCandidates.zhs: 请搜索尚未绑定的普通账号。
EmptyCandidates.en: Search for an unbound regular account.

BindingConfirmation.zhs: 我已核对人员与账号，理解绑定提交后不能解绑、改绑或重绑。
BindingConfirmation.en: I have checked the person and account and understand that this binding cannot be removed or reassigned.

BindingReasonPlaceholder.zhs: 请输入绑定原因（必填，最多 500 字）
BindingReasonPlaceholder.en: Enter a binding reason (required, up to 500 characters)

IDENTITY_REVISION_CONFLICT.zhs: 候选账号已发生变化，请重新搜索并核对后提交。
IDENTITY_REVISION_CONFLICT.en: The candidate account has changed. Search again and review it before submitting.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_INVALID.zhs: 绑定请求不完整，请重新选择账号。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_INVALID.en: The binding request is incomplete. Select an account again.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_REASON_INVAL.zhs: 绑定原因须为 1–500 个字符，且不能全为空白。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_REASON_INVAL.en: Enter a binding reason of 1–500 characters, not only whitespace.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_ACTOR_INVALI.zhs: 无法确认绑定操作者，请重新登录后重试。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_ACTOR_INVALI.en: The binding actor could not be verified. Sign in again and retry.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_NOT_FOUND.zhs: 人员不存在，请刷新列表。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_NOT_FOUND.en: This person no longer exists. Refresh the list.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_PERSON_DISAB.zhs: 人员已停用，不能绑定账号。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_PERSON_DISAB.en: This person is disabled and cannot be bound to an account.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_ALREADY_BOUND.zhs: 人员已永久绑定账号，不能改绑。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_ALREADY_BOUND.en: This person already has a permanent account binding and cannot be reassigned.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_USER_NOT_AVA.zhs: 所选账号不存在或不可绑定，请重新搜索。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_BINDING_USER_NOT_AVA.en: The selected account does not exist or is unavailable for binding. Search again.

ORGANIZATION_USER_ALREADY_BOUND.zhs: 所选账号已绑定其他人员，请重新选择。
ORGANIZATION_USER_ALREADY_BOUND.en: The selected account is already bound to another person. Select another account.

ORGANIZATION_LOCAL_ADMIN_BINDING_FORBIDD.zhs: 本地管理员账号不能绑定人员。
ORGANIZATION_LOCAL_ADMIN_BINDING_FORBIDD.en: The local administrator account cannot be bound to a person.

ORGANIZATION_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE.zhs: 账号服务暂不可用，请稍后重试。
ORGANIZATION_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE.en: The account service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_LIFECYCLE_INVALID.zhs: 人员启停请求无效，请刷新后重试。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_LIFECYCLE_INVALID.en: The person status request is invalid. Refresh and retry.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_LIFECYCLE_REASON_INV.zhs: 启停原因须为 1–500 个字符，且不能全为空白。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_LIFECYCLE_REASON_INV.en: Enter a status change reason of 1–500 characters, not only whitespace.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_LIFECYCLE_ACTOR_INVA.zhs: 无法确认启停操作者，请重新登录后重试。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_LIFECYCLE_ACTOR_INVA.en: The status change actor could not be verified. Sign in again and retry.

ORGANIZATION_PERSON_LIFECYCLE_DEPENDENCY.zhs: 关联账号或会话服务暂不可用，人员状态未完成变更，请稍后重试。
ORGANIZATION_PERSON_LIFECYCLE_DEPENDENCY.en: The linked account or session service is unavailable. The person status change did not complete. Try again later.

LIFECYCLE_CONFLICT.zhs: 人员或关联账号状态已变化，请刷新并核对后重试。
LIFECYCLE_CONFLICT.en: The person or linked account status has changed. Refresh and review it before retrying.

CompanyRequired.zhs: 所属公司与部门须同时填写。
CompanyRequired.en: Select both a company and a department.

DepartmentRequired.zhs: 所属公司与部门须同时填写。
DepartmentRequired.en: Select both a company and a department.

CompanyNotFound.en: The selected company does not exist.

DepartmentNotFound.en: The selected department does not exist.

DepartmentCompanyMismatch.zhs: 所属部门不属于所选公司。
DepartmentCompanyMismatch.en: The selected department does not belong to the selected company.

DepartmentChainDisabled.zhs: 所属部门或其上级部门已停用。
DepartmentChainDisabled.en: The selected department or one of its parent departments is disabled.

PositionNotFound.en: The selected position does not exist.

EmploymentIntervalInvalid.zhs: 任职结束时间不能早于任职开始时间。
EmploymentIntervalInvalid.en: Employment end time cannot be earlier than the start time.

DeleteBlockedByUserBinding.zhs: 已永久绑定账号的人员不能删除。
DeleteBlockedByUserBinding.en: A person with a permanent account binding cannot be deleted.

InvalidId.zhs: 人员标识无效，请刷新后重试。
InvalidId.en: The person ID is invalid. Refresh and retry.

AuthorizationSummaryHelp.zhs: 此处显示已保存的授权摘要；使用对象授权操作查看或调整权限。
AuthorizationSummaryHelp.en: This summary shows saved authorization. Use the object authorization action to inspect or change permissions.
